description: Reviewed exceptions for scripts/audit-gate.mjs (npm run audit:gate): high or critical advisories in `npm audit --omit=dev` that are accepted until their fix lands, with the reason they do not reach request data (docs/SECURITY.md section 7). The gate fails on any high or critical advisory missing here, on an entry that matches nothing, and on an entry past its reviewBy date.

advisories.title: Zod can exhaust memory while validating oversized constrained collections
advisories.reason: zod below 4.6.6 can exhaust memory on oversized collections. JSON bodies are capped at 1 MiB, and chunk uploads are raw bytes that zod never parses.
advisories.fix: The zod 4 migration, together with @asteasolutions/zod-to-openapi 8 or later (both semver-major).

advisories.title: DeepmergeTS has stack exhaustion when merging recursive object graphs
advisories.reason: Prisma 6 pulls in deepmerge-ts through @prisma/config, a dependency of the Prisma CLI only. It runs when Prisma loads its configuration (prisma generate, migrate deploy), not on request data.

advisories.title: Effect: ReDoS in Schema.TemplateLiteral compiled regex
advisories.reason: Same path as deepmerge-ts: effect is required only by @prisma/config, which the Prisma CLI uses to validate its own configuration (prisma generate, migrate deploy), never request data. Not in the 2026-11-12 snapshot; found by the gate on 2026-11-20.
